dogecoin.text: I'm starting to think I'm the only person affected by the great dogecoin crash of 2014.

A lot of people are sharing their crypto currency success stories this week. Here is mine. In 2014 I bought $25 worth of Dogecoin as a joke. I just checked and it’s spiked 700%. I completely forgot my login info and now I have a fortune (~$175) that I cannot access. I am a genius

Is anybody here a cryptocurrency expert? I’d love to talk to you. I remembered my Coinbase password. I thought I bought dogecoin a while back but it turns out I actually bought bitcoin. I guess I threw $25 in back in ‘14 and now it’s worth like $700. Should I sell ASAP?
Ok now I’m rewatching 90s All That and marveling at how insanely talented Kenan Thompson has always been. Anyway Paramount Plus gave me 8 million dollars in unmarked dogecoin to tweet this.
